title: Polynomial-time parity-query policies for explicit Boolean polynomials
description: Research preprint with PDF, LaTeX, complete policy implementation and retained exact validation. For an explicit squarefree Boolean ANF, an attributed construction using Zhang and Moshkovitz-Zhu gives a randomized per-input parity policy with min(n,O(1+4^d log s)) queries and polynomial total bit time/live space. Polynomial anchors, exact rational elimination and bounded kernel repair remove the earlier logarithmic query loss. Every tape terminates with at most n queries; correctness and the smaller bound hold jointly with probability at least1-delta for each fixed input. Fourier data are analysis-only, precision parsing is charged, and cached implementation storage is included. The separate all-coset one-batch theorem is retained. Original full-policy STOP evidence and a separate passing total/partial rank-collapse check are archived without rerunning experiments. No improved existential depth, globally correct sampled tree, established novelty, independent peer review or formal certification is claimed. OpenAI Codex assisted derivation, source comparison, implementation, drafting and packaging.
